datasets.title: Built-up land, 1975–2020
datasets.description: Share of each cell covered by buildings in each GHSL epoch (every 5 years), from Landsat and Sentinel-2. Play it to watch the city grow.
datasets.source: JRC GHSL GHS-BUILT-S R2023A via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Urban growth
datasets.description: Share of each cell built up in 2016 and 2023 (Google Open Buildings Temporal), the change, and the CA-ML probability it is urban by 2035.

datasets.title: Land surface temperature (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean MODIS Terra+Aqua land surface temperature, day and night. Cloudy monsoon months have gaps.
datasets.source: MODIS MOD11A2/MYD11A2 v6.1 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Law & order mobility
datasets.description: Where emergency movement can be choked or sealed off (docs/MOBILITY_MODEL.md).

datasets.title: Vegetation NDVI (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean MODIS 250 m NDVI (Terra+Aqua 16-day composites). Shows the monsoon green-up and the dry-season brown-out.
datasets.source: MODIS MOD13Q1/MYD13Q1 v6.1 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Night lights (monthly)
datasets.description: VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly radiance, stray-light corrected. Tracks built-up activity, electrification and festival lighting.
datasets.source: NOAA EOG VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Air quality: NO₂ column (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean Sentinel-5P TROPOMI tropospheric NO₂ column. Traffic and combustion raise it; native pixels are ~5.5 × 3.5 km, so neighbouring cells share values.
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 NO2 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data, free and open

datasets.title: Air quality: PM2.5 (monthly, modelled)
datasets.description: Monthly mean surface PM2.5 from the CAMS global forecast model (~40 km grid, so whole districts share a value). A model estimate, not a monitor reading.
datasets.source: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service near-real-time forecasts via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Rainfall (monthly total)
datasets.description: CHIRPS satellite-gauge rainfall summed per month. Native pixels are ~5.5 km, so this is drawn on ~3.9 km cells.
datasets.source: CHIRPS v2.0 daily (UCSB Climate Hazards Center) via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Intelligence scores
datasets.description: ~20 composite urban scores (walkability, livability, flood risk…) precomputed per cell from a bulk OSM extract.

datasets.title: Traffic congestion (structural)
datasets.description: Road-network betweenness → level-of-service per cell. Structural congestion, not live delays (docs/TRAFFIC_MODEL.md).
